text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion makes it through the Shuka Sho! And the spectators go wild seeing her have so much fun running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the press conference following the race, she announces that she'll be heading for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup next, earning herself even more attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, an Umamusume whose very name proclaims majesty—Kawakami Princess—challenges the royal descendant Fine Motion! A dramatic showdown between the "princesses" draws near!
